About the author

I'm a scientist-practitioner. What does that mean? It means I conduct applied research (science) and provide evidence-based advice to work teams and organizations (practice). And I write about it, including the book Teams That Work, which helps leaders and team members apply the science of teamwork. I founded and lead The Group for Organizational Effectiveness (www.groupOE.com), a boutique consulting firm that has provided guidance to over 600 organizations globally. At gOE, I’ve supported all sorts of corporate teams, from the boardroom to the manufacturing floor, as well as cancer care teams, oil rig crews, deep sea dive teams, military teams, cruise ships, and even NASA aerospace crews.
